turnLimitScope: One ACP prompt; cancel/stop on any tool-call or client permission request. Top-level --max-turns is not forwarded to the agent branch in the inspected official source.
prompt:
Metadata-only design review; no tools/web. An isolated integration test runs real ManagedConnectors, gateway HTTP, default Composio Gmail parser, desktop managed client, mail ingestion and morning-task flow. ONLY the exact upstream provider-fetch boundary is fake; routes, parsing and persistence are real. No customer accounts or live provider calls.
Give the top 3 concrete acceptance cases covering: authenticated tenant/account binding (never trust a client-selected account); cancellation or revocation while an upstream read is in flight, including a late successful response; retaining previously accepted staff mail/tasks; provider keys held only by gateway, never exposed to clients or diagnostics. A fictional canary key may detect leaks.
Each case must specify setup/interleaving and observable assertions across the real chain, not broad advice. Distinguish fixtures from live integration proof. Return JSON {"cases":[{"title":"...","setup":"...","assertions":["..."]}]} with exactly 3 cases, at most 4 assertions each, under 240 words.
authentication: Existing cached auth via opaque symlink in disposable private GROK_HOME; harness never opens auth contents.

cases.title: Session bind ignores client account
cases.setup: Fixture: A and B server-bound mailboxes; fake Gmail fetch answers only for A. No live provider. Recommended: desktop client auths as A and posts B's id on real gateway HTTP; ManagedConnectors, Composio parser, ingestion, morning-task are real.
assertions: Bound mailbox is A's session only, never client id B.
Fake fetch runs only for A; B is never read.
Mail and morning task persist only on A; B is empty.
No client account override in response or rows.

cases.title: In-flight revoke keeps prior staff work
cases.setup: Fixture: prior staff mail and morning task ingested; second Gmail body blocked on fake fetch. Interleave: real sync, gateway revoke or cancel mid-read, then late success. Parser and store real. Not a live call.
assertions: Late success is not committed after revoke or cancel.
Prior staff mail and morning task stay unchanged.
No new mail or task row from the late payload.
Status stays revoked or cancelled; later sync does not replay.

cases.title: Canary key stays only at the gateway
cases.setup: Fixture canary only in gateway secret at fake fetch boundary. Recommended: authed desktop client runs real HTTP, ManagedConnectors, Composio parse, ingestion, morning-task, and a forced fetch error. Scan client, logs, diagnostics, rows. No customer keys.
assertions: Only gateway fetch boundary sees the canary; client gets none.
Canary absent from HTTP responses, diagnostics, and tasks.
Canary absent from persisted mail, tasks, and errors.
Missing key fails closed at gateway; client is never asked for it.
